spots.export.missing: Export: parkingStatus enabled (other operators allow parking there), deploymentStatus disabled (deploy only after review), deploymentVehicles = suggestion from demand, deploymentRadius 15 m as in the Operations view. The CSV holds only this list – for adding, not for overwriting the whole set.
spots.export.onlyMine: Export: parkingStatus from the feed (returns allowed), deploymentStatus disabled (not in the feed), deploymentVehicles = suggestion from demand. The CSV holds only this list – not for overwriting the whole set.
spots.export.care: Export: no-riding zone and duplicate with parkingStatus disabled (move or merge), always empty despite demand with deploymentStatus enabled (deploy), otherwise status from the feed. The CSV holds only this list – not for overwriting the whole set.
spots.method: Method: a spot belongs to a place if the place’s centre is at most {r} m away; the densest places form first. Demand = trip starts of all operators per measured hour in the cell ({CELL}; {days} days, {h} h) ÷ 95th percentile of the municipality’s cells ({p95}/h), at most 1. Own vehicles without spot ÷ {g}, at most 1. Points = 2 × demand + own vehicles; the number of operators at the place only breaks ties. Duplicates: own spots closer than {d} m; the one with the lowest empty rate stays.
spots.methodBase: Method: a spot belongs to a place if the place’s centre is at most {r} m away; the densest places form first. Own vehicles without spot ÷ {g}, at most 1. Duplicates: own spots closer than {d} m; the one with the lowest empty rate stays.

spots.zonesNote: Zones: {files} zone file(s) of {own} checked. Only a spot inside a zone without ride-through is reported. {n} spots lie in zones without free parking (GBFS ride_allowed = false) – there the spot is usually the permitted area, so it is not a finding.
